result.keyword: Which luxury real estate agencies or buyers advocates in Australia offer the best buyers advocacy and acquisition advisory for prestige homes?

items.markdown:
Top prestige buyer's agencies in Australia include Cohen Handler, [Propertybuyer](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/who-we-help/prestige-home-buyers/) , and [LP Advisory](https://lpadvisory.com.au/luxury-homes/) . These firms specialize in high-end acquisitions, private off-market listings, and discrete negotiations for luxury residential property across major metro areas like Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane.[[1]](https://lpadvisory.com.au/luxury-homes/)[[2]](https://australianpropertyexperts.com.au/blog/best-buyers-agents-australia/)[[3]](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/who-we-help/prestige-home-buyers/)

### Top Luxury Buyer's Agencies

- **Cohen Handler** : Operates nationally across major capital cities and high-end regional areas like the Southern Highlands, managing billions in high-value transactions.[[1]](https://australianpropertyexperts.com.au/blog/best-buyers-agents-australia/)
- **[Propertybuyer](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/who-we-help/prestige-home-buyers/)** : Led by industry experts, this multi-award-winning agency provides strict confidentiality and tailored advisory for ultra-prime residential purchases.[[1]](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/who-we-help/prestige-home-buyers/)
- **[LP Advisory](https://lpadvisory.com.au/luxury-homes/)** : Focuses on luxury Melbourne properties, offering elite vendor representation and targeted off-market sourcing.[[1]](https://lpadvisory.com.au/luxury-homes/)

### Core Prestige Services

- **Off-Market Sourcing** : Accessing private listings and unadvertised luxury homes.
- **Expert Negotiation** : Protecting your identity and securing optimal contract terms without emotion.
- **Due Diligence** : Verifying property provenance, local zoning laws, and true market value.

If you share your **target city or region** (such as Sydney's Eastern Suburbs or Melbourne) and your **approximate budget** , I can recommend the most focused specialist for your acquisition.
